description:
## CONTEXT

This ticket is NOT a feature. It severs and fixes TWO DEFECTS present in the shipped 0.2.0 release (HEAD a9f49dd) that make the review protocol unsafe under real orchestration load. Both were re-derived end to end from source in the 2026-07-03 pipeline review (decision record: workspace N-076). Filed as defects, not enhancements, because each can either brick an honest review or ship a false approve. They are grouped here because they share the same expiry + coverage code paths; the feature-shaped selection and transport work lives in separate tickets.

DEFECT 1 (bricks honest reviews): hop-1-anchored per-lens expiry plus all-or-nothing first submission. `expiresAt` is fixed once at hop-1 as `now + resolveLensTimeoutMs` (src/tools/start.ts:206-208) with per-model defaults of 60s and 120s (src/lenses/registry.ts:86-89). `applyCompletion` rejects the ENTIRE complete call on the first lens whose `now > expires` via an early return inside the results loop (src/state/review-state.ts:445-454), discarding every other lens's valid results. The first submission at status `started` must include every expected lens or it is rejected `missing_lenses` (review-state.ts:458-472), so results cannot be submitted as they arrive; first-complete latency equals `max(all lens latencies) + overhead`, which for real subagents on a real diff exceeds 60s essentially always. Retries reuse the ORIGINAL hop-1 deadline (`buildNextActions`, src/tools/complete.ts:270-272), so attempt 2 is born past the wall clock. Net: an honest late review is permanently unfinishable.

DEFECT 2 (ships a false approve): partial coverage is invisible in the verdict. When lenses die, the caller must fabricate `status:"error"` outputs to pass the missing_lenses gate; error outputs are filtered from the merge (`if (output.status !== "ok") continue`, src/merger/dedup.ts:43) and `computeVerdict` counts only survivors (src/merger/verdict.ts:44-53). `ReviewVerdictSchema` (src/schema/verdict.ts:69-84) has NO per-lens coverage field. So a review with dead core lenses can return `verdict:"approve", findings:[], hadAnyFindings:false` -- indistinguishable from a clean full pass. The verdict downgrade only fires while `nextActions` is non-empty (src/merger/pipeline.ts:99-103); terminal failure removes the downgrade.

DEAD CODE these defects expose: `TaskRecord` statuses `expired` and `in_flight` are declared (src/cache/in-flight.ts:76-82) but never written -- a grep finds only the enum declaration and one skip-check (review-state.ts:351). Error codes `AGENT_TIMEOUT` and `PARTIAL_RESULTS` are declared (src/schema/error-code.ts:22,25) with ZERO producers (grep over src/). The timeout taxonomy the release advertises is unwired.

## VERIFIED STATE @ a9f49dd

All citations above were re-derived at HEAD. Key confirmations: expiry set at start.ts:206-208; per-lens early-return rejection at review-state.ts:445-454; started-state completeness gate at review-state.ts:458-472; finalize-time union coverage at review-state.ts:480-498; retry reuses hop-1 deadline at complete.ts:270-272; error-status filtered from merge at dedup.ts:43; verdict envelope has no coverage field at verdict.ts:69-84; downgrade only while nextActions non-empty at pipeline.ts:99-103; `expired`/`in_flight` unwritten (in-flight.ts:76-82, review-state.ts:351); `AGENT_TIMEOUT`/`PARTIAL_RESULTS` producerless (error-code.ts:22,25).

## SCOPE

1. Re-anchor expiry per attempt. Each `NextAction` mints a fresh deadline at emission time (replace the hop-1 reuse at complete.ts:270-272). Ideally start each lens's clock at its `lens_review_get_prompt` fetch rather than at hop-1.
2. Per-lens acceptance in `applyCompletion` (review-state.ts:445-454): accept every valid non-expired result; record each expired lens as a terminal task with status `expired` + errorCode `AGENT_TIMEOUT` (wiring the two dead identifiers); never discard the batch for one expired lens.
3. Incremental submission before finalize: drop the started-state `missing_lenses` gate (review-state.ts:458-472) in favor of the existing finalize-time union coverage check (review-state.ts:480-498), so the caller may submit results as they arrive.
4. Realistic default timeouts: raise `DEFAULT_LENS_TIMEOUT_MS` (registry.ts:86-89) to real subagent latencies (minutes, not seconds), since the caller does the spawning.
5. `lensCoverage[]` in the verdict envelope: add to `ReviewVerdictSchema` (verdict.ts:69-84) one entry per expected lens -- `{ lensId, status: ok|error|skipped|expired|parse_failed|cached, attempts, contributedFindings }`. Enforce via `superRefine` that verdict cannot be `approve` when any CORE lens (the four lenses whose SURFACE_RULES entry is `"core"` -- security, error-handling, clean-code, concurrency, registry.ts:130-134) lacks an `ok` or `cached` contribution; cap at `revise`, set `coverage:"partial"`, and surface `PARTIAL_RESULTS` in the envelope.

## OUT OF SCOPE

The delta/reviewId payload protocol (LF6); merger severity/dedup correctness (LF3); the adjudication gate (LF4); selection changes (LF7). This ticket fixes expiry re-anchoring and coverage disclosure only.

## ACCEPTANCE

- Test: a complete call where one of several lenses is past its deadline accepts the others and marks the expired lens `expired` with `AGENT_TIMEOUT`; no whole-batch rejection.
- Test: two sequential partial submissions finalize successfully without fabricated error placeholders.
- Test: a review missing a core lens (e.g. security has no `ok`/`cached` contribution) returns verdict at most `revise` with `coverage:"partial"` and `PARTIAL_RESULTS`, even when zero findings exist -- the false-approve is impossible.
- Test: an attempt-2 retry emitted after the original hop-1 deadline carries a fresh future `expiresAt`.
- `lensCoverage[]` length equals `expectedLensIds` length; a `superRefine` ties the reported statuses to reality (mirror the count invariants at verdict.ts:86-96).
- The `expired` `TaskRecord` status and the `AGENT_TIMEOUT` / `PARTIAL_RESULTS` codes now have live producers (a grep proves they are no longer dead).

## PITFALLS

- Dropping the started-state gate must NOT weaken the finalize-time union check (review-state.ts:480-498) -- that is now the only completeness guard.
- Per-attempt deadlines interact with the non-contiguous-attempt check (review-state.ts:435-444); keep attempt monotonicity intact.
- The verdict schema already forbids `approve` with pending `nextActions` (verdict.ts:183-189); the new core-coverage cap is an ADDITIONAL rule -- do not remove the existing one.
- The "core lens" set must be read from a single source (registry SURFACE_RULES) so LF7's selection changes cannot desync it.

## VERIFICATION

Simulate a real run: start a multi-lens review, submit the majority of results as `ok` and let two exceed a short test deadline, then finalize; assert the verdict is `revise`/`partial` with `lensCoverage` naming the two expired lenses, and confirm a reader looking only at `findings` can no longer mistake it for a clean pass.

## SIZING

L. state/review-state.ts, schema/verdict.ts, merger/pipeline.ts, tools/complete.ts, lenses/registry.ts. Portable enough for the lowest permitted execution tier because each change is a localized correctness fix with a pinned test.

Cross-link: workspace N-076. Independent of LF1. Pairs downstream with workspace WF2 (three-value judge), which can consume `lensCoverage`/`PARTIAL_RESULTS`.

PLAN-REVIEW RULINGS (2026-07-04, wave 3b, binding):

The wave-3 plan (rev 2) was rejected at the plan gate after two review rounds (round 1: 3 Codex findings + 7 adversarial findings; round 2: 3 Codex findings + 4 adversarial findings incl. one BLOCKING). Every distinct gate finding is folded in below as a binding ruling; all disputed facts were re-derived at HEAD 770cfd5 (T-030 landed after the VERIFIED STATE section above was written; see R15 for anchor drift). The next planner MUST satisfy every ruling. Default disposition everywhere: the reviewer's concrete fix is ADOPTED as specified.

R1 (resolves the round-2 BLOCKING finding: duplicate redelivery of an accepted ok submission after that lens's deadline gets diverted to expired, violates verdict superRefine rule (e), ReviewVerdictSchema.parse throws after the session is already finalized, caller gets an internal error and every later call gets DUPLICATE_COMPLETE, review permanently bricked; zero-findings variant silently misreports a contributing core lens as expired and downgrades an honest approve). The past-deadline diversion to expired MUST apply ONLY to a result that would otherwise be ACCEPTED: attempt === highestSeen + 1 AND the lens has no accepted ok output in perLensLatestOutput. Verified geometry at 770cfd5: stale_attempt whole-batch rejection at src/state/review-state.ts:425-433, non_contiguous_attempt at :435-444, the review_expired whole-batch rejection this ticket deletes at :445-454. Required per-result disposition order: (1) a result for a lens already in perLensExpired is silently diverted (output dropped, attempts untouched, coverage stays "expired", no parse error per R4); (2) a result failing the acceptance test above falls through to today's stale_attempt / non_contiguous_attempt rejection exactly as at HEAD and must NOT be diverted to expired; (3) a would-be-accepted result past its lens deadline is diverted to newly-expired (attempt = highestSeen + 1, output NOT stored, lens joins perLensExpired); (4) a past-deadline result for a lens already covered by an ok latest output must NEVER transition that lens to expired, regardless of attempt number: it is ignored (not stored) and the lens's coverage stays "ok". Consequence: no contributing lens can ever be reported "expired", so superRefine rule (e) (expired entries have contributedFindings === 0) can never throw post-finalize. MANDATED TEST: ok in-window submission, deadline lapses, duplicate attempt-1 resubmission -> stale_attempt rejection, lens still reported "ok" in lensCoverage, review still finalizable with its findings intact.

R2 (resolves the round-2 MAJOR restart-durability finding, same root cause as R1). Writer-side invariant, enforced and documented: NO code path may write a task record with status "expired" for a lens whose highest terminal record carries an ok lensOutput. R1's guard removes the only producer of that geometry; additionally the expired-record writer (persistExpiredBestEffort or equivalent) MUST skip (best-effort log) any lens whose latest accepted output has status "ok", and carry an invariant comment stating the rule. MANDATED TEST: extend the restart-durability coverage beyond non-terminal-shadows-terminal to the terminal-expired-shadows-terminal-completed geometry: after an ok attempt-1 completion, no later expired record may erase that lens's output from perLensLatestOutput on rehydration.

R3 (resolves the round-2 Codex major architecture finding at src/tools/complete.ts:467 AND the round-2 MINOR interim-round-flood finding; one ruling, same root cause, resolved consistently). Session round persistence is terminal-only: persistRoundBestEffort / writeSessionRound (appends unconditionally at src/cache/session.ts:188; called after every successful applyCompletion at src/tools/complete.ts:467 today) MUST be gated on the computed finalize flag (envelope reviewComplete === true). Interim envelopes, including empty polls and accepted partial submissions, persist ZERO round records, so a caller polling a long review cannot inflate the session file or pollute the cross-round series consumed downstream (T-029). In-flight task records ARE persisted for accepted partial submissions (that is their purpose). persistLensCacheBestEffort MAY continue to run on interim calls (the per-lens overwrite is idempotent at HEAD); if the planner keeps interim lens-cache writes the plan must say so explicitly. MANDATED TESTS: (a) a two-step partial review leaves exactly ONE session-cache round record after the finalizing call; (b) a sequence of empty interim polls appends zero round records.

R4 (resolves the round-2 Codex major edge-cases finding at src/tools/complete.ts:316). parseErrors[] must not name a lens that this call diverted to expired or that was already in perLensExpired. At HEAD, per-lens payload parsing happens at complete.ts:319-360 BEFORE applyCompletion (:396); either classify expiry before parsing or strip parse errors for lenses applyCompletion reports as expired. The final envelope must never report the same lens as both a timeout and a parse failure; coverage for such a lens is "expired". MANDATED TEST: an expired lens submitting malformed output yields lensCoverage "expired" plus PARTIAL_RESULTS, no retry NextAction, and no parseErrors entry for that lens.

R5 (resolves the round-2 Codex minor feasibility finding on the once-per-attempt anchor marker under partial disk failure). The prompt-fetch anchor must stay once-per-attempt even when a disk write fails partway. Required order: write the attempt-1 in_flight task record FIRST; only if that flip succeeds, update index.lensMeta[lensId].expiresAt (hydration reads deadlines exclusively from index.lensMeta, src/state/review-state.ts:324-333, so a flipped record without a deadline update is harmless: no extension happened, and the flip still blocks re-anchoring). Additionally keep an in-memory per-process anchored set so repeated get_prompt calls never re-anchor within the process even if disk reads misbehave. MANDATED TEST (failure injection): the task rewrite fails after/around the index update path; a second get-prompt call does not extend the deadline again.

R6 (resolves the round-2 MINOR cross-ticket wording desync with T-032). LENS_ERROR_MESSAGES.REVIEW_EXPIRED (src/schema/error-code.ts:43-44) must be reworded to neutral text that does NOT claim the code is unproduced. Required text: "The review's retained state expired; start a fresh review round." Rationale verified in-repo: sibling wave ticket T-032 scope item 4 produces REVIEW_EXPIRED again for hops against reviews past the 24h in-flight TTL (DEFAULT_TTL_MS, src/cache/in-flight.ts:51). Do not add any "noted for a follow-up filing" framing; the follow-up already exists as T-032 scope item 4. The REVIEW_EXPIRED enum value itself is kept (backward-compatible schemas rule).

R7 (resolves round-1 Codex major architecture at src/cache/in-flight.ts and the round-1 adversarial CONFIRMED post-restart brick finding on reanchorLensDeadlines task writes). Deadline durability lives in the index, never in task records. Re-anchoring persists via an index.lensMeta read-modify-write ONLY; the retry path in complete.ts must not touch task records at all. The ONLY non-terminal task write after registration is the safe same-attempt pending -> in_flight flip at prompt fetch: it rewrites the record for that exact attempt only when its status is "pending", never writes a record at an attempt above the highest terminal attempt, and never overwrites a terminal record. Harden readAllTasks (src/cache/in-flight.ts:283-303) to terminal-preferred selection: the highest-attempt TERMINAL record (completed/failed/expired) per lens wins; the highest non-terminal record is used only when the lens has no terminal record (hydrateFromDisk's anyTerminalTask derivation must keep working). Replace the "file a follow-up ticket" warning in the doc comment at in-flight.ts:271-282 with the new selection contract. MANDATED TEST: server restart after a retry NextAction is emitted and before the attempt-2 submission; hydration preserves perLensAttempts and perLensLatestOutput and the attempt-2 submission is accepted.

R8 (resolves round-1 Codex major feasibility on get-prompt re-anchoring enabling indefinite deadline extension). Prompt-fetch anchoring is once-per-attempt and never resurrects: re-anchor only when (a) the lens has no terminal attempt and its attempt-1 task record has status "pending" (the in_flight flip is the durable once marker per R5), and (b) now <= the lens's current perLensExpiresAt. A fetch after the deadline returns the prompt but leaves the old deadline intact; the lens is then expired by the R9 sweep. Retry attempts never anchor via get_prompt; the retry deadline is minted exactly once in buildNextActions (replacing the hop-1 perLensExpiresAt reuse at src/tools/complete.ts:270-272 with a fresh now + perLensTimeoutMs mint, re-anchored server-side so the wire value equals the enforced value).

R9 (resolves round-1 Codex major edge-cases on stale "skipped" disclosure for timed-out never-submitted lenses). Eager expiry sweep on EVERY applyCompletion call, including empty polls and interim calls, running BEFORE the finalize union check: every expected lens that is not cached, not already in perLensExpired, has no perLensLatestOutput, no accepted submission in this call, and whose deadline has passed joins perLensExpired / the returned expiredLenses list (attempt = highestSeen + 1, advancing nextAttempts) and is persisted with an AGENT_TIMEOUT expired task record. Interim envelopes disclose "expired", not "skipped", for such lenses even when finalize cannot fire yet.

R10 (resolves the round-1 adversarial CONFIRMED runtime-cycle finding; the round-2 reviewer independently ratified this as necessary, not optional). The core lens single source MUST be a new leaf module src/lenses/core-lens-ids.ts exporting CORE_LENS_IDS = ["security", "error-handling", "clean-code", "concurrency"] with ZERO runtime imports (type-only LensId import), consumed by BOTH src/lenses/registry.ts (builds the four "core" SURFACE_RULES entries; at 770cfd5 those live at registry.ts:145-149) and src/schema/verdict.ts (imports the LEAF directly, never registry). Importing from registry would be a real ESM cycle: verified at 770cfd5, src/lenses/prompts/index.ts:51 does export * from "./shared-preamble.js" and src/lenses/prompts/shared-preamble.ts:1-6 VALUE-imports LensStatusSchema / SeveritySchema from ../../schema/index.js. MANDATED TEST: a module-eval smoke test importing schema/index.js and lenses/registry.js in both orders.

R11 (resolves the round-1 adversarial CONFIRMED test-accounting finding; enumeration re-verified by name at 770cfd5, where the baseline is 599/599 in 27 files, NOT the 575 the old plan claimed). The plan MUST enumerate and deliberately rewrite exactly these existing pins: test/state-review.test.ts:276 "rejects a submission past expiresAt with review_expired" (becomes: batch accepted, expired lens diverted per R1); test/tools-complete.test.ts:459 "submission past expiresAt returns isError with errorCode=REVIEW_EXPIRED" (becomes: normal final envelope, isError false, verdict revise via core cap, coverage partial, errorCodes [PARTIAL_RESULTS], lensCoverage expired); test/tools-complete.test.ts:519 "missing-lenses submission produces the 'missing expected lens result(s)' error" (becomes: interim envelope, reviewComplete false, errorCodes []); test/tools-complete.test.ts:1350 "section 8c-10: omitting a non-cached lens still returns missing_lenses" (becomes: interim envelope, cached + skipped coverage); and ALL THREE lens-timeout default pins at test/lens-timeout.test.ts:75, :82, :89 (updated to the new defaults per R14f; the object-form tests using 60_000 as INPUT are unaffected). test/state-review.test.ts:202 "rejects a first submission missing a lens (missing_lenses)" and the :655 pin "neither provided nor cached covers an expected lens" MUST stay green UNMODIFIED via the retained finalize union check. Any full-envelope toEqual assertions gain the four new defaulted fields mechanically; sweep for pins on the complete.ts tool description text.

R12 (resolves the round-1 adversarial CONFIRMED acceptance-3 and acceptance-4 script defects). Acceptance test 3 (partial coverage) must use the object timeout form {default: long, opus: short} with an explicit lens list so ONLY the opus lens expires; assert the final verdict on the finalizing submission call itself (revise, coverage partial, PARTIAL_RESULTS, lensCoverage naming the expired lens), then pin that a trailing empty poll returns DUPLICATE_COMPLETE. Acceptance test 4 (fresh retry deadline) must assert (a) the minted retry expiresAt is strictly later than the hop-1 agents[].expiresAt and (b) an attempt-2 resubmission after the original hop-1 deadline but inside the freshly minted window is accepted; pin the post-original-deadline geometry with a deterministic injected-now unit test (nextActions are minted in the same call as the attempt-1 error result, so the wall-clock route cannot occur without a get_prompt re-anchor step).

R13 (resolves the round-1 adversarial minor doc-drift finding). Same-commit contract updates required: src/schema/review-protocol.ts NextActionSchema doc (expiresAt is no longer "computed server-side at hop-1"; past-expiry resubmissions are no longer "rejected with REVIEW_EXPIRED at hop-2"); src/lenses/registry.ts timeout doc at :96-99 (the "rejects hop-2 resubmissions past that wall-clock deadline" promise becomes false); the wire-visible lens_review_complete tool description in src/tools/complete.ts (mention incremental submission: results may be a subset or empty as a status poll, server finalizes only when every expected lens is covered or expired, interim envelopes carry reviewComplete false); CLAUDE.md hop-2 output list and RULES.md section 4 bullet updated the same way; REVIEW_EXPIRED message wording per R6. No em dashes in any of it.

R14 (ratifies the rev-2 design decisions that resolved the round-1 observation on PARTIAL_RESULTS semantics and the spec's open points; both round-2 reviewers verified these against source; adopt unchanged). (a) No new wire input: CompleteParams results stays a plain array (empty-results poll is wire-legal today); finalize = !willEmitRetries AND unionCovered, where covered = this call's in-window submissions, plus perLensLatestOutput, plus cachedResults, plus perLensExpired, plus lenses now past deadline; the finalize-time union check (src/state/review-state.ts:480-498) STAYS as the only completeness guard, extended to count expired lenses as covered, and still rejects a finalize missing a non-expired lens. The started-state missing_lenses gate (:458-472) is deleted. (b) ReviewVerdictSchema gains four defaulted fields so existing consumers parse unchanged: lensCoverage (default []), coverage full|partial (default "full"), errorCodes (default []), reviewComplete (default true). Interim envelopes are reviewComplete false and can never carry approve. (c) PARTIAL_RESULTS appears in errorCodes iff at least one lensCoverage entry has status "expired" (timeouts only; merely-awaiting "skipped" lenses and retry-pending rounds do not fire it), matching LENS_ERROR_MESSAGES.PARTIAL_RESULTS. AGENT_TIMEOUT lives on expired task records. (d) superRefine additions a-f per the rev-2 plan: distinct lensIds; core-coverage cap (approve invalid when any CORE_LENS_IDS entry is outside ok/cached); coverage partial iff any entry outside ok/cached; PARTIAL_RESULTS iff any expired entry; contributedFindings reality tie with expired/skipped entries at 0; interim discipline (reviewComplete false requires verdict !== approve AND coverage partial). All ADDITIONAL to the existing rules at src/schema/verdict.ts:86-189; the nextActions approve rule at :183-187 and the pipeline downgrade at src/merger/pipeline.ts:100-103 are untouched, and the pipeline gains the core-coverage cap and the interim cap beside them. (e) Coverage status precedence per lens: in perLensExpired -> "expired"; else latest output ok -> "ok"; else latest error starting with "parse failure" -> "parse_failed"; else other latest error -> "error"; else cached -> "cached"; else "skipped". With R1 this can never mislabel a contributing lens. (f) DEFAULT_LENS_TIMEOUT_MS (src/lenses/registry.ts:100-103) raised to {default: 600_000, opus: 1_200_000}. (g) The internal review_expired ApplyCompletionResult variant and its rejectionToLensErrorCode arm are deleted (internal type, not wire schema); the wire enum value stays per R6. (h) IndexRecordSchema.lensMeta gains optional timeoutMs (no schema-version bump); registerReview persists it; hydrateFromDisk falls back to resolveLensTimeoutMs(meta.model, undefined) for old index files.

R15 (baseline re-anchor so the next plan does not repeat the stale-baseline defect). Plan against HEAD 770cfd5: npm test 599/599 in 27 files (~1s); tsc --noEmit clean; tools-complete EEXIST stderr is documented failure-injection noise, those tests pass. Anchor drift from the VERIFIED STATE section above (written at a9f49dd), re-verified at 770cfd5: DEFAULT_LENS_TIMEOUT_MS now at registry.ts:100-103 (doc promise at :96-99); SURFACE_RULES core entries now at registry.ts:145-149; prompts/index.ts export-star now at :51. Unchanged at 770cfd5: review-state.ts stale/non-contiguous/review_expired at :425-454, started-state gate at :458-472, finalize union at :480-498, hydration deadline read at :324-333, pending/in_flight skip at :351-353; complete.ts buildNextActions deadline reuse at :270-272, persist helpers at :467-473, applyCompletion call at :396; in-flight.ts task statuses at :76-82, readAllTasks at :283-303 (doc :271-282); session.ts unconditional round append at :188; dedup.ts non-ok filter at :43; error-code.ts REVIEW_EXPIRED :43-44, PARTIAL_RESULTS :46-47, AGENT_TIMEOUT :52-53, both timeout codes still producerless at HEAD (grep-verified). Wave context: T-027 is on the 1.5.0 critical path (workspace ISS-822 Option A); T-030's centralized confidence floor is ratified and lives in the shared preamble only; nothing in this ticket may move it into lens bodies.

PLAN-REVIEW RULINGS ROUND 2 (2026-07-04, wave 3b gate, binding; extends the wave 3b round-1 rulings):
R-B1. Retry issuance is a durable ordered transition: persist the accepted terminal task record BEFORE publishing pendingAttempt/emitting the retry nextAction; the retry-marker write returns success or failure (no silent swallow) and on failure the retry action is NOT emitted; alternatively hydration must reconcile pendingAttempt N with a missing terminal attempt N-1 without rejecting the in-window retry as non-contiguous. Mandated failure-injection test: index update succeeds, task write fails, process restarts, attempt-2 submission is still accepted.
R-B2. Deadline anchoring is on the wire or it does not exist: either add expiresAt to GetPromptOutputSchema and return the re-anchored deadline from the prompt-fetch anchor, or drop attempt-1 re-anchoring entirely and re-anchor only via retry nextActions where the refreshed deadline is already carried. Pick ONE and state it in the plan; silent server-side extension invisible to the caller is forbidden.
R-B3. Submitted lens IDs must belong to session.expectedLensIds: planCompletion drops or rejects (typed) any submitted lensId not expected for this review BEFORE attempt/deadline handling, so an unactivated lens can never influence findings, hadAnyFindings, retries, or coverage. Mandated test: a valid-but-unactivated lens output affects nothing.

PLAN-REVIEW RULINGS ROUND 4 (2026-07-04, wave 3d, binding):

The wave-3c plan (rev 2) was parked at the plan gate after round 3: one BLOCKING R10 violation, four Codex majors, one Codex minor, one non-blocking accounting note, and a VERIFIED CLEAN record covering everything else. Every finding is folded in below as a binding ruling; all disputed facts were re-derived at HEAD 770cfd5. The next planner MUST satisfy every ruling below IN ADDITION to R1-R15 and R-B1..R-B3. Each ruling fixes ONE required design; none may be re-litigated. A plan believing a ruling is wrong STOPS and quotes it rather than deviating.

R-D1 (resolves the round-3 BLOCKING R10-violation finding; pen ruling: remedy (a), NO amendment to R10). The core-lens single source lives at src/lenses/core-lens-ids.ts exactly as R10 mandates. It exports CORE_LENS_IDS = ["security", "error-handling", "clean-code", "concurrency"] written as `as const satisfies readonly LensId[]`, with a TYPE-ONLY import of LensId (LensId is exported at src/lenses/prompts/index.ts:146; a type-only import is erased at compile time, so the leaf has ZERO runtime imports and is exactly as cycle-free as any other placement). It is consumed by BOTH src/lenses/registry.ts (builds the four "core" SURFACE_RULES entries, at 770cfd5 registry.ts:145-149) and src/schema/verdict.ts, which imports the LEAF directly (../lenses/core-lens-ids.js), never registry: the registry route is a real ESM cycle because src/lenses/prompts/index.ts:51 export-stars shared-preamble.js and src/lenses/prompts/shared-preamble.ts:1-6 VALUE-imports ../../schema/index.js. The rejected variant: the parked plan's src/schema/core-lens-ids.ts placement with a test-file-only LensId conformance check. The plan updates the import paths in its registry, verdict, and pipeline sections to the lenses-located leaf. KEPT UNCHANGED from the reviewed plan: the both-orders module-eval smoke test (import schema/index.js then lenses/registry.js and the reverse order), the content pin on the four ids, the runtime Object.keys(LENSES) membership check, and the bidirectional SURFACE_RULES tie test.

R-D2 (resolves the round-3 Codex major architecture finding at src/tools/complete.ts:324: two behavior sources for unexpected-lens handling). planCompletion is the SINGLE source for raw-result disposition. complete.ts MUST NOT pre-filter submitted lensIds against session.expectedLensIds anywhere. It fetches the session early, converts every parsed wire entry into an internal submission candidate, and calls planCompletion(session, submissions, now) on the UNFILTERED candidate list. planCompletion applies the R-B3 unexpected-lens drop inside its disposition (after the duplicate guard on the original results, before attempt/deadline handling), and complete.ts derives parseErrors[], retry-candidate filtering, and ignoredLensIds exclusively from the returned disposition. The only lens filtering that remains inside complete.ts is the existing wire-boundary rejection of ids that are not LensIds at all (the `!(r.lensId in LENSES)` terminal parseError at complete.ts:327-331 at HEAD), which is a parse concern, not a disposition concern. Direct API callers of planCompletion therefore observe behavior identical to the wire path for valid-but-unactivated lenses, including parseErrors, retryCandidates, ignoredLensIds, and coverage. MANDATED TEST: submitting a valid-but-unexpected lens output through the tool and passing the same candidate to planCompletion directly produce the same disposition (dropped, ignoredLensIds naming it, no coverage entry, no retry, no influence on findings or hadAnyFindings).

R-D3 (resolves the round-3 Codex major feasibility finding at src/schema/verdict.ts:69: the schema cannot see expectedLensIds). ReviewVerdictSchema does NOT gain an expectedLensIds input; the exact-set guarantee lives in complete.ts. A validation step runs IMMEDIATELY before ReviewVerdictSchema.parse (the parse call sits at complete.ts:454 at HEAD): it asserts that the built verdict's lensCoverage lensIds equal session.expectedLensIds EXACTLY as a set (no omission, no extra, no duplicate). On mismatch it throws an internal error naming the missing/extra ids, surfaced through the tool's existing internal-error envelope; a mismatch is an invariant break (server bug), never a caller error. MANDATED TEST: a synthetically omitted lensCoverage entry for an expired core lens trips the exact-set assertion instead of parsing as coverage "full" with an approve verdict.

R-D4 (resolves the round-3 Codex major architecture finding at src/tools/start.ts:198: split deadline contract). The deadline contract on the wire is two-tier and documented as such: agents[].expiresAt in the lens_review_start response is the pre-fetch PROVISIONAL deadline (the field is KEPT, not removed or renamed; backward-compatible schemas rule), and the expiresAt returned by lens_review_get_prompt (R-B2 Option A, ratified in R-D8) is the AUTHORITATIVE spawn deadline. Callers MUST use the get_prompt expiresAt for execution timeouts. Required same-commit doc updates, all stating the provisional/authoritative split: the StartOutputSchema agents[].expiresAt field doc and the start tool description (start.ts:96 and :116 at HEAD), the registry timeout doc at registry.ts:96-99 (already being reworded per R13), README.md, the CLAUDE.md hop-1/hop-1.5 sections, and the RULES.md section 4 hop bullets. MANDATED TESTS: (a) for an anchored attempt-1 fetch, get_prompt expiresAt is greater than or equal to the start response agents[].expiresAt for that lens; (b) any existing test that treats agents[].expiresAt as the enforced execution deadline is updated to fetch and assert against the get_prompt expiresAt instead.

R-D5 (resolves the round-3 Codex major edge-cases finding at src/cache/in-flight.ts:283: terminal selection underspecified across attempts). Per-lens record selection during hydration follows this DOCUMENTED TOTAL ORDER, implemented as a named pure comparator with its own unit tests: (1) discard any record with status "expired" whose attempt is higher than a terminal record carrying an ok lensOutput for the same lens (a corrupt or late expired record never erases a prior ok; this is the reader-side mirror of the R2 writer invariant and formalizes the R2-over-literal-R7 reader rule); (2) among the remaining records, the highest-attempt TERMINAL record (completed/failed/expired) wins, so failed@2 beats ok@1 (a later failed attempt is the latest lens state) while ok@2 beats expired@3 via rule 1 and expired@2 beats failed@1; (3) non-terminal records are used only when the lens has no terminal record at all (R7's terminal-preferred selection unchanged); (4) at equal attempt, prefer completed/failed over expired over non-terminal, and, defensively, completed over failed (that pair cannot coexist at one attempt via the writer; the tiebreak exists solely to keep the order total). The readAllTasks doc comment at in-flight.ts:271-282 is replaced with this contract (consistent with R7's replacement mandate). MANDATED COMPARATOR TESTS at minimum: failed@2 over ok@1; ok@2 over expired@3; expired@2 over failed@1; completed@1 over pending@2; pending@1 selected when no terminal record exists; equal-attempt completed over expired.

R-D6 (resolves the round-3 Codex minor testability finding at src/cache/in-flight.ts:254: brittle global single-shot failure hooks). Failure-injection hooks are scoped by OPERATION and by target: _failNextIndexRmwForTests({ reviewId }) and _failNextTaskWriteForTests({ reviewId, lensId, attempt }) (names may follow the plan's prevailing convention; the scoping is mandatory). A hook fires only when every scope field matches the operation's arguments, is single-shot, and every pending hook is cleared by _resetForTests (review-state.ts:577 at HEAD is the existing reset seam; the in-flight module's hook clearing runs in that same test-reset path). Unscoped global failure hooks are forbidden.

R-D7 (resolves the round-3 NON-BLOCKING R11-accounting note on registerReview's new per-lens timeout parameter; conservative ruling). The parameter is OPTIONAL: registerReview (src/state/review-state.ts:176 at HEAD) gains perLensTimeoutMs?: ReadonlyMap<LensId, number> (or the plan's equivalent shape) and, when omitted, derives each lens's timeout via resolveLensTimeoutMs(model, undefined) (registry.ts:109), the same fallback R14(h) already mandates for hydrating old index files. Stated consequence for the R11 pin accounting: test/state-review.test.ts receives NO edits beyond the single R11-mandated rewrite of the :276 pin; in particular the register() helper at :42 and the pinned tests at :202, :516, and :655 stay byte-identical. New coverage for the fallback lives in a new or non-pinned test file.

R-D8 (RATIFICATION; resolves the round-3 VERIFIED CLEAN record). The following dispositions from the reviewed rev-2 plan are RATIFIED as the implementable design and MUST be reused verbatim by the next plan, not redesigned: the satisfaction of R1-R9 and R11-R15 as specified; R-B1 via the alternative branch (hydration reconciles pendingAttempt N with a missing terminal attempt N-1 without rejecting the in-window retry as non-contiguous), correctly declared; R-B2 via Option A (GetPromptOutputSchema gains expiresAt and the prompt-fetch anchor returns the re-anchored deadline; the schema sits at src/tools/get-prompt.ts:48-53 at HEAD with no exact-shape pins in tools-get-prompt.test.ts), correctly declared; the R-B3 dispositions, now seated inside planCompletion per R-D2; the R1 disposition order with the stale_attempt-over-expiry tiebreaker; the R2-over-literal-R7 ok-beats-expired reader rule, now formalized as R-D5 rule 1; and the section-0 correction that CompleteParamsSchema's superRefine (src/schema/params.ts:96-108, pinned by test/schema.test.ts:907) already rejects duplicate lensIds on the wire, so no new wire-boundary duplicate guard is added. Deviating from a ratified disposition is an automatic revise at the plan gate unless a later rulings round explicitly amends it.
title: Expiry and partial-coverage integrity -- fix two ship-blocking defects in the 0.2.0 review protocol
